identity.title: Verify Matching no-result, multiple-result, and score boundaries

origin.summary: 2D-031 requires a focused contract for Matching no-result, multiple-result, score threshold, acceptance, overlay, and Run History meaning.

state.current_summary: 2D-031 Matching no-result, multiple-result, and score-boundary meaning is verified through the existing SDK/pipeline, acceptance, overlay, XML, and Run History owners; no detector, score recalculation, or candidate abstraction was added.

objective.summary: Prove that Matching no-result, multiple-result, and score threshold cases retain the declared ResultCount, Score metrics, acceptance, overlays, and report evidence while controlled no-result remains fail-closed and deterministic.
constraints: Reuse the existing Matching tool, VisionRecipeRunner, acceptance, overlay summary, and Run History owners; do not add a detector, candidate abstraction, or alternate score calculation.
Use isolated synthetic template/source fixtures and D-drive evidence only; preserve XML/save-reopen semantics.
Do not touch Original, release, deploy, hardware, or external systems.

criteria.text: A no-result source fails with the existing controlled MatchingNoResult meaning and does not fabricate a match overlay or positive result count.
A source with multiple spatially distinct targets respects NUM_MATCH and preserves ResultCount, ScoreMin/ScoreMax, overlay, and acceptance meaning.

Score threshold just below an observed candidate retains the candidate and a threshold just above it rejects it without changing unrelated routing; XML reopen and Run History preserve the observed boundary evidence.
Focused Debug/Release contract and documentation record the existing owner/call path and unverified WPF/render/hardware limits.

evidence.observation: Debug Matching boundary contract passed: blank source failed closed as MatchingNoResult without a positive ResultCount or overlay; NUM_MATCH=2 retained two results, ordered finite scores, two overlays, acceptance, XML reopen, and Run History export; the observed score boundary was accepted below and rejected above the configured SCORE_MIN.
Release Matching boundary contract passed with the same no-result, multiple-result, score threshold, overlay, XML reopen, acceptance, and Run History observations as Debug.

Focused expected-failure and Preview/Run/Reopen regressions exited 0 for Mean, Blob, Contour, Matching, and Line, including locale coverage; Debug/Release builds completed with 0 errors and only the existing 16 nullable warnings.

Documentation records the existing Matching owner/call path, SCORE_MIN fraction versus percentage score meaning, NUM_MATCH/result/overlay contract, explicit fixture preprocessing, next 2D-032 priority, and the unverified WPF EXE/theme/DPI/monitor/hardware limits.

events.summary: Close 2D-031 as a deterministic contract-only slice: retain the existing Matching SDK/result owners, prove no-result, NUM_MATCH multiple-result, score threshold, acceptance, overlay, XML, and Run History semantics, and leave WPF/runtime qualification outside this slice.
All 2D-031 criteria have active Debug/Release contract and focused regression evidence with durable documentation; the remaining WPF/runtime qualification is explicitly outside this slice.
